rationale: User-authorized physical restricted MO-gradient convergence is the standard-control all-electron FP64 Direct CUDA RHF default, aligning the stopping norm with unchanged stock GPU4PySCF. Explicit strict and tighter energy or density controls retain AO-max convergence. Unsupported default owners retain strict behavior; explicit unsupported orbital requests fail closed. Resource, checkpoint and captured-plan identities bind the policy. DF HF and KS policies are unchanged. Common independent complete energy/force gates remain mandatory; this is not a 1e-7 maximum-force guarantee or a universal speedup claim.
revisit_condition: Requalify changes to the norm, thresholds or eligible owners against independent energy/force oracles and complete cold/warm endpoints. Preserve strict accuracy overrides, unsupported-owner fallback, raw DIIS history, source/image provenance and unchanged reference-engine settings. Do not substitute historical opt-in timings for qualification of a changed default image.
